messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **federal holidays** in Canada that create **long weekends** during the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know—some provinces add extra holidays that also generate long weekends.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Dec 31 – Jan 2 (includes the preceding Saturday) |
| Family Day | Feb 20 | Monday | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Jul 1 – Jul 3 (includes the following Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Friday | Nov 10 – Nov 12 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 23 – Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) is a federal holiday but falls on a Tuesday, so it does *not* form a long weekend on its own.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day in BC, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Alberta; St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario; etc.) that can also create long weekends. If you need those, just let me know!
